metadata.title: Arm Stock: Earnings Show It Has an Apple and Android Problem<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Arm Stock Has an Apple and Android Problem
It’s a story that’s played out several times already this earnings season: investors have stopped rewarding artificial-intelligence growth, and are instead punishing companies that show signs of weakness in their legacy businesses.
